mapper.select: SELECT im.species_id, im.individual_id, im.morph_id, mm.morph_name, im.bloodline_id, bm.bloodline_name, mm.inheritance_category, im.expression_category, im.possible_het_percentage, im.sort_order, im.create_user, im.create_at, im.update_user, im.update_at FROM individual_morph im INNER JOIN morph_master mm ON mm.species_id = im.species_id AND mm.morph_id = im.morph_id LEFT JOIN bloodline_master bm ON bm.species_id = im.species_id AND bm.morph_id = im.morph_id AND bm.bloodline_id = im.bloodline_id WHERE im.species_id = #{speciesId} AND im.individual_id = #{individualId} ORDER BY im.expression_category, im.sort_order, im.morph_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO individual_morph ( species_id, individual_id, morph_id, expression_category, bloodline_id, possible_het_percentage, sort_order, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at ) VALUES ( #{speciesId}, #{individualId}, #{morphId}, #{expressionCategory}, #{bloodlineId}, #{possibleHetPercentage}, #{sortOrder}, #{createUser}, #{createAt}, #{updateUser}, #{updateAt} )
